status: API GUIDANCE MASK ONLY — NO IMAGE REQUEST SENT, NO CLAIM CREATED BY THIS TOOL

semantics.transparentMeans: EDITABLE — the model may repaint this pixel
semantics.opaqueMeans: PROTECTED — the model must leave this pixel alone
semantics.rgb: 0,0,0 on every pixel, transparent and opaque alike — the mask carries no pixel of the figure
semantics.invertedRelativeToD133: D-133's marker fixtures use the OPPOSITE convention: alpha 255 marks the region. This file is their alpha-inverse, restricted to the EDIT region.
semantics.guidanceOnly: MODEL GUIDANCE ONLY. The guarantee that nothing outside the head changes comes from D-133's deterministic recomposition copying PROTECT back from H1 byte-identically — never from this mask.

differsFromD139Mask.why: the band pre.transition-silhouette requires to be identical is no longer offered to the model as editable

invariants: alpha = 0 on exactly the D-133 CORE region (EDIT minus TRANSITION), and nowhere else
alpha = 255 everywhere else, and nowhere else
RGB = 0,0,0 on every pixel; the mask contains no pixel of the figure
it differs from the D-139 mask by exactly the 1702 TRANSITION pixels
the same inputs and tool version reproduce every output byte-identically

prohibitions.notTheByteIdentityGate: This mask is model guidance. It is NOT the guarantee of 0 changed pixels outside the head — that guarantee is D-133's deterministic recomposition, which copies PROTECT back from H1 byte-identically.
prohibitions.noRuntimePromotion: An authoring fixture. It is NOT a runtime mask and carries no runtime authority.
prohibitions.noRefit: A deviation from D-133's approved counts is a hard stop. The region is never re-fitted.
